basic_info.description: I am currently pursuing a degree in Computer Engineering at Suan Sunandha Rajabhat University. I have built a solid foundation in Java and Python through coursework and academic projects. I also have basic knowledge of network management. I am a proactive learner eager to gain real-world experience and apply my skills to solve practical problems.

projects.title: Website Development & Hosting
projects.description: A prototype project focused on practicing website development with the support of AI-assisted coding tools using PHP. Gained experience in designing routing layers and linking system functions to ensure correct page rendering. Implemented load balancing to efficiently allocate limited resources (using an old PC as a server), configured secure domain settings, analyzed server logs, and blocked malicious IP addresses.

projects.title: Research Project
projects.description: Computer Engineering research project titled “Wheatgrass Care Cabinet via Pet Application,” presented by Asst. Prof. Dr. Ravi Uttamathanin and research team members at the 25th National Graduate Research Conference (GNRU) under the theme “AI: A New Dimension of Education for the Future.” The project received a ‘Very Good’ presentation award in the oral presentation category.

projects.title: Multimedia Content Creation
projects.description: Created instructional media for off-the-shelf software usage Pre-configured Treatment Template Usage. Produced Thai-language voice-over training media Blood Gas Analyzer Operation Manual. Created troubleshooting tutorial videos for internal staff Zoncare Ultrasound System Restore.

experience.title: Intern
description: Responsible for managing telecommunication number records within a government organization, including the cancellation of Public Numbers and User Numbers via the CRM system. Prior to cancellation, verified invoice status and accuracy through the CIP system to ensure compliance with organizational requirements.

Provided support to officers and team members in customer data management, ensuring smooth and efficient operations. Gained exposure to structured workflows and standardized processes within a large-scale organization, while developing proficiency in internal systems such as CRM and CIP.

Developed a solid understanding of government customer management systems, enhanced data verification and attention-to-detail skills, gained teamwork experience, and acquired foundational knowledge of public telecommunication services.

experience.title: Content Moderator (Work from Home)
description: Performed content moderation through the Azar application by randomly monitoring video calls to observe, analyze, and evaluate user behavior in accordance with company policies and standards. Identified and reported inappropriate behavior such as explicit or policy-violating actions.

Recorded incident details accurately and escalated cases to relevant departments for further action, while maintaining high levels of diligence and respecting user privacy under data protection standards.
Enhanced understanding of social platform user behavior, improved decision-making and content assessment skills, and strengthened focus and ethical responsibility in content safety operations.

experience.title: Master TV System Operator
description: Managed and controlled television channel distribution through the Master TV system within the hotel, ensuring accurate channel configuration, audio-visual quality, and compliance with hotel standards.
Coordinated with technical teams to troubleshoot and resolve system issues, performing continuous improvements and maintenance.
Gained experience with real-time streaming protocols, Master TV control software, channel management, and hardware selection alongside system technicians to maintain optimal signal quality.

experience.company: MDV Solution and Account Co., Ltd.
experience.title: IT Support
description: Provided technical support for medical-related web applications used in veterinary clinics, including integration with devices such as printers, barcode scanners, and blood analyzers. Assisted with installation, routing, and configuration of system add-ons such as LINE notifications and IDEXX integrations.
Resolved computer hardware, software, and network issues within the organization, installed and configured programs, and maintained records of maintenance and installations for reporting purposes.
Developed strong technical support skills, troubleshooting expertise, and effective communication abilities when providing guidance to end users.
